## Research question

How did the residual Laurentide Ice Sheet influence early Holocene hydroclimate in the northeastern United States?

## About the project

My ongoing work on Owasco Lake uses vegetation-corrected plant-wax isotope records to investigate postglacial hydroclimate in the northeastern United States, including early Holocene influences of the residual Laurentide Ice Sheet.

## Approach

Plant-wax δ²H, vegetation correction, and sedimentary archives.
